const results = await Promise.allSettled([
tools.exec_command({cmd:"python - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
class PageParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.ids = []
        self.links = []
        self.headings = []
        self.lang = None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'html': self.lang = a.get('lang')
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
        if 'href' in a: self.links.append(a['href'])
        if tag.startswith('h') and len(tag) == 2 and tag[1].isdigit(): self.headings.append(tag)
p = Path('index.html')
html = p.read_text()
parser = PageParser()
parser.feed(html)
assert parser.lang == 'ko'
assert len(parser.ids) == len(set(parser.ids)), 'duplicate IDs'
assert parser.headings == ['h1', 'h2', 'h3'], parser.headings
assert '민지' in html and '디자이너입니다.' in html
for link in parser.links:
    assert not urlparse(link).scheme, f'external dependency: {link}'
    if link.startswith('#'): assert link[1:] in parser.ids, f'broken anchor: {link}'
    else: assert Path(link).is_file(), f'missing file: {link}'
css = Path('styles.css').read_text()
assert css.count('{') == css.count('}')
assert '@media (max-width: 600px)' in css
assert '@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)' in css
assert ':focus-visible' in css
assert 'url(' not in css and '@import' not in css
print('PASS: Korean content, heading hierarchy, unique IDs, all local links/anchors, CSS braces, responsive rules, focus styles, reduced-motion support, no external dependencies.')
